verdict.rationale: A built-in AI assistant is a plausible capability for an identity-verification SaaS platform, so the axis applies. However, the evidence shows no assistant inside the product to which users can delegate tasks. Workflows and Cases automations are rule-based automation, an adjacent feature, and llms.txt only serves documentation to external AI agents.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
